svg.aria-label: WavesLing. Draws fell from 71.9% to 23%. WavesLing is a daily 5×5 board puzzle where every tide moves your pieces and your rival's at once. Its rules, its opening and the prices of its pieces were decided by simulating games, not by taste. The daily puzzle: pick a direction and every piece that answers it moves at once.
